taskTitle: Where ten HTTP header fields are defined

checks.detail: 0 state changes, each allowed by a review (0 reviews in all)
1 phase had the tools designed for them

finalText:
All ten fields are defined in RFCs that are still current. I opened each RFC page on rfc-editor.org and copied the quotes from the section that defines the field. The RFC 6797, 8288, 9110 and 9111 pages I read show no "Obsoleted by" notice. I also ran one search for later RFCs that might replace 6797 or 8288, and it turned up none.

- **Age, Cache-Control, Expires:** RFC 9111 (HTTP Caching) defines them in sections 5.1, 5.2 and 5.3. https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9111.html
- **Last-Modified, ETag, Location, Retry-After, Vary:** RFC 9110 (HTTP Semantics) defines them in sections 8.8.2, 8.8.3, 10.2.2, 10.2.3 and 12.5.5. https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html
- **Strict-Transport-Security:** RFC 6797 defines it in section 6.1. https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6797.html
- **Link:** RFC 8288 defines it in section 3. https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8288.html

The pages wrap lines in the middle of sentences, so I joined each quote into single-spaced text. I chose quotes that stay inside the field's own section, and I escaped the double quotes in the Last-Modified quote.
